name: 彩色課本淡鉛筆補強模型（實驗）
architecture: 120 depth-3 gradient boosted decision trees over connected ink components

training.source: ten local third-party comparison pairs; sparse reviewed weak labels

augmentation.splitUnit: source page, variants never cross splits

limitations: Small English workbook dataset; not a general Chinese/Zhuyin model
Comparison outputs contain defects and are not clean ground truth
Cannot infer hidden original printed pixels
Development regression only; reference pages already reviewed in earlier versions
Confirmed printed examples are keep labels; overlapping strokes may remain
Repair uses local inpainting and observed guide pixels; no trained image generation
